title: Over the Limit/Skill history

{{skill history}}

== [[Feedback:Game updates/20260826|August 26, 2026]] ==
* Cast time bonus increased from 15..20 to 20..50, recharge bonus increased from 15..50 to 40..80. Increased amount of Overcast generated from 1 to 3.

== April 30, 2020 ==
* Increased the recharge bonus of Over the Limit to 15..50.
* Fixed a bug that allowed Over the Limit to cause Overcast higher than the user's maximum energy capacity
